question: Does a localized RBS perturbation produce a measurable hierarchical response beyond its matched mechanism-null?

scientific_scope.added_degree_of_freedom: prospective causal perturbation experiment with matched mechanism-null contrast (D vs N1); zero new TFNE architecture
inherited_from_e4: E1 hierarchy identity and FF/FB ownership
E3 sparse owned D1/D2a H_K RBS on A2:L5:E (flat_indices 70-76)
E4 downstream observation chain S -> Q -> F -> P -> Y
Experiment A canonical relative Q and conservative primary F/P operators
single neural trajectory per arm/seed then post-hoc observation
excluded: new TFNE layers or operators beyond frozen E1-E4 stack
new F_H dynamics beyond validated D2a on owners
scientific_scope.architecture_rule: E5 adds causal perturbation evidence only; implementation must not introduce new compile-time topology, delays, RBS ownership, or observation definitions

composition_ladder.containment: E1 subset E2 subset E3 subset E4 subset E5_evidence
composition_ladder.display: hierarchy + delays + local RBD + observation + causal perturbation assay
composition_ladder.post_close_policy: hard 0.4.17 scientific feature freeze; subsequent work is publication evidence consolidation (Figures 1-7), not E6

coupling_operator.reference: identity when Gamma_H = I => b_eff = b

perturbation_timing.display: H_K(t_0^+) = 1.2 on O_H at simulation onset
perturbation_timing.F_H: tau_K * dH_K/dt = 1 - H_K on O_H only (D2a autonomous recovery; inherited from E3)

experimental_arms.label: reference
experimental_arms.purpose: unperturbed reference arm; aligns with E3-null / E4 reference neural path

experimental_arms.label: state_only_null
experimental_arms.H_K_dynamics: same as D (D2a recovery on O_H)
experimental_arms.purpose: matched hidden-state perturbation without RBS expression; tests implementation leakage

causal_contrast.display: mechanism attribution requires matched mechanism-null; not D vs N0 alone

null_invariants.Gamma_H_split: Gamma_H^N1 = I while Gamma_H^D(H_K) = H_K * b

causal_contrast.forbidden_interpretation: D vs N0 without N1 does not establish mechanism attribution

propagation_assay.display: H_K -> X_owner -> X_A2 -> X_A1 -> Q -> Y

secondary_outcomes.statement: propagation to A2 non-owner, A1, Q, Y is scientifically informative but not required for E5 success
secondary_outcomes.A1_pathway_interpretation: any A1 response is structural propagation via frozen FB pathway A2->A1, not FF/FB functional/spectral claim

response_vector.display: (Delta X_owner, Delta X_A2/nonowner, Delta X_A1, Delta Q, Delta Y)
response_vector.metric_policy: use simple frozen-system metrics only; no new spectral analysis pipeline

rules.NO_EFFECT: D and N1 remain indistinguishable at owner level despite sufficient numerical/activity quality
rules.LOCAL_EXPRESSION: owner-level D-N1 effect passes preregistered threshold; downstream propagation criteria fail
rules.HIERARCHICAL_PROPAGATION: owner effect and preregistered downstream propagation criteria pass
rules.UNRESOLVED: activity or numerical quality insufficient for classification

result_classification.success_policy: E5 may close with any classified outcome; HIERARCHICAL_PROPAGATION is not required

owner_primary.note: any nonzero owner contrast above numerical noise floor at float32 fidelity

downstream_secondary.note: preregistered exploratory propagation; failure still permits LOCAL_EXPRESSION close

observation_workflow.rule: one neural trajectory per arm and seed -> freeze X,H,B,Q,G -> apply E4 F/P; never rerun neural model per observation operator

simulation_policy.sample_size_policy: fixed at E1-E4 seeds; do not add seeds unless prospectively amended
